measures.existing: a witness whose place existed before the fix (unchanged or rewritten lines)
measures.fixed: a witness of the fixed program: the two conditions
measures.prefix: a pre-fix witness: the three conditions
measures.prefix_tested: a pre-fix witness on a line a historical test executes
measures.tested: a witness on a line a historical test executes
measures.unchanged: a witness in code the fix did not touch
measures.unchanged_executed: a witness in untouched code on a line a test executes

statistics.paired_test: two-sided bootstrap p-value of the paired difference, Holm over all pairs
